newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania says no to Polish Kredyt Bank branch.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania says no to Polish Kredyt Bank branch.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Thursday that it had rejected a request by Poland's Kredyt Bank SA to establish a branch in the Baltic state.
"The Board of the Bank of Lithuania said no to Kredyt Bank's application," a central bank spokeswoman told Reuters.
"It (Kredyt Bank) did not meet the requirements set by the central bank for setting up a branch in Lithuania," she added, but gave no further details.

Kredyt Bank, which opened a representative office in Lithuania last year, was the first foreign bank to apply for permission to open a branch here after parliament passed a law in June lifting a ban on foreign bank.
The law was passed in response to a crisis which rocked Lithuania's banking sector late last year with the surprise closure of two of its top banks.
